coordinates: Two-dimensional projections of normalized 128-dimensional vectors; no model weight arrays.
query_sample: Every eighth selected evaluation position (1,024 points per view), four positions from each of 256 evaluation documents; no token/document identities exported.
shared_axes: Within each view, queries, trained residents and initial residents use exactly the same basis and origin. Each space has independent coordinates.
variance: Centered explained variance evaluated on all 8,192 evaluation queries and all 109 trained residents for that space.
caveat: Projected separation or overlap is not a native activation test: radius support is computed in the original 128 dimensions.
